title: Vision tuning
description: Gameplay tuning owned by the Vision domain (Vision Bible; ADR-016 §9): how often the server works out what each team and player sees, and how far each kind of unit sees. VeyraVision binds it to FVeyraVisionTuning.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's format. A build reads exactly one version.

update.description: How often vision is worked out on the server (ADR-016 §2). Targeting and replication read the same pass, so they always agree.

provenance.description: Where these values come from (ADR-008 §7). Canon gives none; League's answers stand in (ADR-016 §11).

updateSeconds.description: Seconds between two passes; a unit stepping into sight shows at most this late.

sight.description: How far each kind of unit sees, in units (Vision Bible §1). Wildlife gives no vision.

provenance.description: Where these values come from (ADR-008 §7). Canon gives none; League's answers stand in (ADR-016 §11).

structure.description: A structure's sight radius: Spires, base towers, inhibitors and the Prime Well.
